question: Why is one led to true guru according to scripture?
premises: in Śrīpūrva scripture it is said
for accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation
inference: Scripture says one is led to true guru for spiritual accomplishment.
plain_english: In the Śrīpūrva scripture it is said by him: desiring, by Śiva's will, for accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation, one is led toward the true guru.
